cards.back: The manual’s safety guidance also directs yielding to pedestrians outside crosswalks and when your traffic signal is green.

cards.back: Stop completely for a pedestrian crossing with a guide dog or white cane.

cards.back: Do not pass a vehicle that has stopped or is slowing to yield to someone in a crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Yield to pedestrians when making.
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians when making a permitted turn on red.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for people beside parked or stopped vehicles.
cards.back: Watch for people beside parked or stopped vehicles, and check behind before backing in parking lots.

cards.back: At a school crossing, stop and yield when directed by the crossing guard.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Follow the reduced school-zone speed when warning.
cards.back: Follow the reduced school-zone speed when warning lights flash or children are present outside.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before crossing a sidewalk, yield.
cards.back: Before crossing a sidewalk, yield to pedestrians and cyclists using it.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Exercise care to avoid striking pedestrians.
cards.back: Exercise care to avoid striking pedestrians or cyclists regardless of other traffic rules.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A bicycle is a vehicle, and its.
cards.back: A bicycle is a vehicle, and its rider shares vehicle drivers’ road rights and responsibilities.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Search deliberately for cyclists because their smaller.
cards.back: Search deliberately for cyclists because their smaller, quieter vehicles lack the enclosure of a car.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Expect differences in cycling skill and be.
cards.back: Expect differences in cycling skill and be ready for an unexpected swerve or turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Yield where a bicycle path.
cards.back: Yield where a bicycle path or bicycle lane crosses the road.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive, stop or park in a bicycle.
cards.back: Do not drive, stop or park in a bicycle lane except while entering or leaving a driveway or alley.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When overtaking a cyclist, allow at least three.
cards.back: When overtaking a cyclist, allow at least three feet between the cyclist and your vehicle’s right side.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow for an approaching or overtaken cyclist and.
cards.back: Slow for an approaching or overtaken cyclist and let the rider clear an intersection before you turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Cyclists generally ride as far right as practical, but.
cards.back: Cyclists generally ride as far right as practical, but may choose another position when staying right is unsafe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a lane too narrow for safe side-by-side.
cards.back: On a lane too narrow for safe side-by-side travel, a cyclist may ride near its center.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Check carefully for cyclists before a.
cards.back: Check carefully for cyclists before a turn or opening a vehicle door.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Give cyclists room to avoid.
cards.back: Give cyclists room to avoid potholes, debris and drain grates.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid suddenly slowing or stopping.
cards.back: Avoid suddenly slowing or stopping in front of a cyclist.

cards.front: Complete the rule: In bad weather, increase both following.
cards.back: In bad weather, increase both following room and passing room around cyclists.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reduce passing speed around cyclists.
cards.back: Reduce passing speed around cyclists, especially on a narrow road.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Make a right turn near a cyclist only when.
cards.back: Make a right turn near a cyclist only when it can be completed reasonably safely without interfering with lawful bicycle travel.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Near a bicycle, sound the horn only for a.
cards.back: Near a bicycle, sound the horn only for a collision risk, because the noise can startle the rider.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for a cyclist entering your lane.
cards.back: Watch for a cyclist entering your lane, particularly a child riding from a sidewalk.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not cut sharply across a cyclist’s.
cards.back: Do not cut sharply across a cyclist’s path or force the rider off the road.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Although cyclists should travel with traffic.
cards.back: Although cyclists should travel with traffic, search for riders approaching from any direction.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use added care near cyclists.
cards.back: Use added care near cyclists on wet pavement, sand or gravel.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A cyclist may need both hands on the bars.
cards.back: A cyclist may need both hands on the bars and be unable to give a hand signal, so also watch head and shoulder checks.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before opening a parked vehicle’s door.
cards.back: Before opening a parked vehicle’s door, check the side and rear for bicycles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The recommended Dutch reach opens the driver’s door with.
cards.back: The recommended Dutch reach opens the driver’s door with the right hand to encourage a look over the roadside shoulder.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Check for cyclists before backing and.
cards.back: Check for cyclists before backing and use extra care near schools or homes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Maine does not require a bicycle-driving license.
cards.back: Maine does not require a bicycle-driving license, but traffic-rule violations by cyclists can bring fines.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A cyclist should practice before entering traffic.
cards.back: A cyclist should practice before entering traffic and avoid traffic demands beyond their skill.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Secure bicycle loads on a rack, in bicycle bags.
cards.back: Secure bicycle loads on a rack, in bicycle bags or on a trailer rather than hanging them from the bars or carrying them in the arms.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual requires riders under sixteen to wear helmets.
cards.back: The manual requires riders under sixteen to wear helmets and use passenger seats while traveling on public ways.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A cyclist continuing straight should use through.
cards.back: A cyclist continuing straight should use through traffic’s path rather than a right-turn-only lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Cyclists should ride with traffic and.
cards.back: Cyclists should ride with traffic and avoid passing motorists on the right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The bicycle hazard-scan example looks fifty to one hundred.
cards.back: The bicycle hazard-scan example looks fifty to one hundred feet ahead for grates, potholes, tracks, puddles and debris.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual advises crossing railway.
cards.back: The manual advises crossing railway tracks at right angles while cycling.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When cycling beside parked vehicles, the manual.
cards.back: When cycling beside parked vehicles, the manual recommends three or four feet of door clearance.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Ride a predictable line, avoid weaving between parked.
cards.back: Ride a predictable line, avoid weaving between parked cars and check over the shoulder before changing position.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before a bicycle turn or lane change, look.
cards.back: Before a bicycle turn or lane change, look, signal and confirm the destination path is clear.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a vehicle-style left turn on a bicycle.
cards.back: For a vehicle-style left turn on a bicycle, check behind, signal and move left only when clear.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A cyclist can instead make a left turn in.
cards.back: A cyclist can instead make a left turn in two crossings, moving straight across, pulling aside and crossing left when safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual’s bicycle night equipment includes a white front.
cards.back: The manual’s bicycle night equipment includes a white front lamp visible at least two hundred feet ahead and a red or amber rear lamp or reflector visible at least two hundred feet behind.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reflective bicycle pedals are recommended unless reflective.
cards.back: Reflective bicycle pedals are recommended unless reflective material is worn on the feet or ankles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Cyclists should allow extra stopping room in.
cards.back: Cyclists should allow extra stopping room in rain and carry suitable clothing and water.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Motorcyclists share other drivers’ road rights and.
cards.back: Motorcyclists share other drivers’ road rights and responsibilities; motorcycle licensing uses a separate manual.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Allow a motorcycle an entire lane, including when.
cards.back: Allow a motorcycle an entire lane, including when passing; do not squeeze alongside within the same lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Check mirrors and blind spots.
cards.back: Check mirrors and blind spots carefully for small, less visible motorcycles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Look ahead and to the sides before a left.
cards.back: Look ahead and to the sides before a left turn and wait for an oncoming motorcycle to pass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flashing motorcycle turn signal may have been.
cards.back: A flashing motorcycle turn signal may have been left on because it does not always cancel automatically.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Leave at least a four-second following gap behind a.
cards.back: Leave at least a four-second following gap behind a motorcycle and increase it when the road is wet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Expect a rider to change speed or lane position.
cards.back: Expect a rider to change speed or lane position to avoid potholes, loose material, slick spots, seams or railway crossings.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Large vehicles have extensive blind spots despite.
cards.back: Large vehicles have extensive blind spots despite their mirrors, so avoid remaining in those areas.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Never pass behind a.
cards.back: Never pass behind a reversing bus or truck.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a large vehicle’s mirrors are not visible.
cards.back: If a large vehicle’s mirrors are not visible to you, its driver probably cannot see you.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Allow buses and trucks extra.
cards.back: Allow buses and trucks extra room for acceleration, braking and turning.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A large vehicle can lose speed sharply uphill or.
cards.back: A large vehicle can lose speed sharply uphill or gain it quickly downhill, so avoid taking away its operating space.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When a large vehicle follows you, leave ample.
cards.back: When a large vehicle follows you, leave ample room ahead so both drivers have time to respond.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not pull or pass in front of.
cards.back: Do not pull or pass in front of a large vehicle that is already slowing or stopping.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A truck or bus may swing left before a.
cards.back: A truck or bus may swing left before a right turn; watch its position and signals and stay clear of the turn path.

cards.front: Complete the rule: No-Zones are large-vehicle blind areas.
cards.back: No-Zones are large-vehicle blind areas at the front, rear and sides.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual identifies a truck’s largest side blind.
cards.back: The manual identifies a truck’s largest side blind area on its right, extending rearward from the cab.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid lingering beside a large vehicle because a.
cards.back: Avoid lingering beside a large vehicle because a sudden lane change or swerve can cause a collision.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After passing a large vehicle, wait until its whole.
cards.back: After passing a large vehicle, wait until its whole front is visible in your rearview mirror before returning to its lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not tailgate a truck to draft in.
cards.back: Do not tailgate a truck to draft in its wake; close following also blocks your view ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When stopped behind a large vehicle uphill.
cards.back: When stopped behind a large vehicle uphill, leave room for possible rollback as it starts.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Wait until a large vehicle completes its.
cards.back: Wait until a large vehicle completes its turn before making a turn into its path.

cards.front: Complete the rule: To reduce wind effects from an oncoming truck.
cards.back: To reduce wind effects from an oncoming truck, use the rightmost portion of your own lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If uncertain about an oncoming truck’s speed.
cards.back: If uncertain about an oncoming truck’s speed, wait for it to pass before turning left.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop behind intersection stop lines.
cards.back: Stop behind intersection stop lines so large vehicles have turning clearance.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not cut ahead of a truck or race.
cards.back: Do not cut ahead of a truck or race it into a construction section that narrows to one lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Give large vehicles additional space on every.
cards.back: Give large vehicles additional space on every side in bad weather or limited visibility.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On slick roads, avoid maneuvers that force.
cards.back: On slick roads, avoid maneuvers that force a bus or truck to brake unnecessarily.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Following a large vehicle too closely both hides you.
cards.back: Following a large vehicle too closely both hides you from its driver and limits your view of the road.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Dim headlights when following a large vehicle.
cards.back: Dim headlights when following a large vehicle at night to avoid glare in its mirrors.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before passing a large vehicle, inspect ahead, behind.
cards.back: Before passing a large vehicle, inspect ahead, behind and the side you intend to move toward.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pass a large vehicle only in a legal passing.
cards.back: Pass a large vehicle only in a legal passing area and only when the maneuver can be completed without speeding.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Check over your shoulder before returning to the.
cards.back: Check over your shoulder before returning to the right lane after passing a bus or truck.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a large vehicle passes you, stay to the.
cards.back: If a large vehicle passes you, stay to the right within your lane until it clears and maintain speed or ease off slightly.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On wet roads, start the wipers before a.
cards.back: On wet roads, start the wipers before a passing large vehicle throws spray across your view.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Yield to an emergency vehicle using flashing lights and.
cards.back: Yield to an emergency vehicle using flashing lights and a siren by pulling to the road edge and stopping.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Clear an intersection before pulling aside for.
cards.back: Clear an intersection before pulling aside for an emergency vehicle; do not block the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not follow a fire truck responding.
cards.back: Do not follow a fire truck responding to an alarm within five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a police stop, pull to a safe place.
cards.back: For a police stop, pull to a safe place on the right and remain inside unless asked to leave the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: During a police stop, shut off the engine, switch.
cards.back: During a police stop, shut off the engine, switch on hazard flashers and open the window for communication.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a night police stop, switch on the.
cards.back: At a night police stop, switch on the interior light so the officer can see inside.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stay calm and keep seat belts fastened.
cards.back: Stay calm and keep seat belts fastened during a traffic stop, including those of passengers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep hands on the steering.
cards.back: Keep hands on the steering wheel during a traffic stop.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If an officer requests license, insurance or registration, explain.
cards.back: If an officer requests license, insurance or registration, explain where it is and reach slowly while keeping one hand on the wheel.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not try to.
cards.back: Do not try to flee a traffic stop.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For an emergency vehicle stopped at the roadside, slow.
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle stopped at the roadside, slow and yield; change into the next lane when possible and safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If moving over is unsafe, slow down.
cards.back: If moving over is unsafe, slow down and pass the stopped emergency vehicle cautiously.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The rear orange-and-red reflective or fluorescent triangle identifies.
cards.back: The rear orange-and-red reflective or fluorescent triangle identifies a vehicle traveling below twenty-five miles per hour

cards.front: Complete the rule: Approach a slow-moving vehicle cautiously and.
cards.back: Approach a slow-moving vehicle cautiously and pass only after confirming it is safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for farm equipment crossing rural roads or using.
cards.back: Watch for farm equipment crossing rural roads or using highways, and pass carefully because its operator may not see or hear you.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow and pass animals or animal-drawn vehicles cautiously.
cards.back: Slow and pass animals or animal-drawn vehicles cautiously because a startled animal may rear, swerve or stop.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Horse riders and horse-drawn vehicles share.
cards.back: Horse riders and horse-drawn vehicles share the road and follow vehicle traffic rules.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid using the horn or revving the engine near.
cards.back: Avoid using the horn or revving the engine near an animal, and never deliberately frighten an animal ridden, driven or led near a public way.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for animal-drawn traffic turning left into a field.
cards.back: Watch for animal-drawn traffic turning left into a field or driveway and heed signs warning of that traffic.
